about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Senior software engineer with 10+ years building production software for fintech and SaaS. My depth is Angular and TypeScript architecture, and my work runs across the stack: designing GraphQL schemas, building API integrations end to end, and being on call for production systems. Lately I lead AI-assisted development on my team, co-architecting our MCP server and writing the shared rules and CI automation that make AI tools reliable in production codebases.

experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.description: In 10+ years I've taken products from prototype to production, from enterprise dashboards for major financial institutions to a SaaS platform serving 500+ clients.
experience.point1: Took Tarvent from concept to 500+ clients, including Fortune 500 companies
experience.point2: Helped architect GraphQL schemas and enforce API contracts in CI across frontend and backend teams
experience.point3: On call for production systems, using Azure Monitor alerting, health checks, and autoscaling to maintain 99.9% uptime

ai.title: AI-Assisted Engineering
ai.subtitle: Building the tools, context, and guardrails that make AI a reliable part of the development workflow.
ai.intro: I treat AI as engineering infrastructure, not a novelty. My focus is the layer between models and real codebases: giving assistants the right context through rules, skills, and MCP servers, composing agents into workflows, and keeping output to the same quality bar as hand-written code.

delivery.title: AI-Assisted Delivery
delivery.description: Daily use of Claude Code and Cursor across planning, implementation, refactoring, and debugging, with agent skills and multi-agent workflows for recurring tasks.

mcp.title: MCP Server
mcp.description: Co-architected the team's Model Context Protocol server and built its TypeScript proof of concept, giving AI assistants internal context and tools through a standard interface.

guardrails.title: Quality Guardrails
guardrails.description: Paired AI speed with deterministic checks: a CI task that lints the GraphQL schema before merge, plus mandatory human review of every production-bound pull request.

enablement.title: Team Enablement
